sources.title: [2608.08640v1] SkillReason: Reasoning-Enhanced Agent Skill Retrieval ...
sources.snippet: In Stage II, a retrieval-guided GRPO objective encourages the model to explore reasoning trajecto- ries better suited to its own capabilities and more effective for retrieval. At inference, SkillReason directly encodes the orig- inal query without autoregressive CoT generation, preserv- ing efficient query-only retrieval.
